supported_fields.mechanics: Chargeable beam Ultimate with a 20-hit reference. Rapid input increases charge/damage; the user is invulnerable while charging and attackers who touch the user during charging are paralyzed. Current skill evidence reports 25% base and 35% fully charged damage.

limits: 25%/35% are source-reported reference values, not asserted as universal patch-independent damage.
No Ultimate Finish-only gate or reward probability is inferred.
No exact charge duration or frame timing is promoted.
